title: Shared Cell
statement: Implement `solve(ops)`. Two operations share one integer cell, starting at 0. `inc` adds 1. `read` leaves it unchanged. Return the list of cell values after each operation. An increment must be visible to a later read, which is the point of one cell rather than two copies.
hints: One variable is the cell. Both operations close over it.
inc changes it. read only reports it.
Append the value after every operation.

approaches.name: Direct
approaches.explanation: Two functions that close over the same variable see the same writes.

editorial: Two functions that close over the same variable see the same writes. If each call created a new integer, a read would stay at 0 after increments. The shared cell is what makes the sequence cumulative.
